svg.title: Two plans from the same start: one planned forward, heading short of the vision, and one planned back from it, heading for it.
svg.desc: Two lines over the same time, both starting from today at the lower left. The vision sits at the upper right, highlighted. Both lines stop a little before the vision's time, each ending in an arrowhead: the work goes on. The first line, planned forward, climbs in a straight line and is heading for a point about halfway up, well short of the vision. The second, planned back from the vision, stays low at first, crosses the straight line about two thirds of the way along, then climbs steeply, heading for the vision.
